name: IHeatSink
doc: Injected IO port for heat and telemetry output at room boundaries.

members.name: Emit
members.doc: Emit a heat signature representing information loss. Returns true if successfully recorded.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/BoundedGSet.Tests.fs:bounded heat adapter keeps empty heat cold
laws.doc: Empty heat does not spend heat-channel capacity.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/BoundedGSet.Tests.fs:bounded heat sink no-forget policy backpressures without losing stored heat
laws.doc: When a bounded heat sink is full in no-forget mode, the rejected heat is reported as backpressure and existing stored heat remains intact.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/BoundedGSet.Tests.fs:bounded heat sink rolling policy reports recursive heat explicitly
laws.doc: If the heat channel itself forgets a prior heat signature, that loss is recorded as storage heat.
